title: Short complete notes
content:
Atomicity makes a transaction an all-or-nothing operation.

Consistency preserves database rules before and after a transaction.

Isolation prevents concurrent transactions from observing intermediate changes.

Durability preserves committed changes after a restart.

A primary key uniquely identifies a row in a table.

A foreign key references a key in another table.
summary: Atomicity makes a transaction an all-or-nothing operation. Consistency preserves database rules before and after a transaction. Isolation prevents concurrent transactions from observing intermediate changes. Durability preserves committed changes after a restart. A primary key uniquely identifies a row in a table. A foreign key references a key in another table.
